en: A sepia-toned historic image showing a riverside quay with sailboats docked along the river and a cobblestone street running parallel to the water. There are several people—adults and children—walking or standing along the quay, and a horse-drawn cart can be seen. The street is lined with classic European buildings and leafless trees, suggesting it is taken in colder months. Traditional streetlamps line the road. The left margin features the publisher information, and there are names identifying the location at the bottom.
